'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hey there. See what’s going on? Bitcoin plunges into the abyss. I don’t know if that’s a conspiracy or a logical pattern. This whole business was shady from the start, but well, there’s nothing left to do but to salvage what we can. To cut the long story short, my farm is acting up lately - bugs, freezes, and everything. Fix me up with some wires and capacitors. I have a little idea on how to improve the system stability. And make sure it's all new and untouched!}}

== Requirements==
* Must be level 30 to start this quest.

==Objectives==
* Find 5 [[Bundle of wires]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
*Find 5 [[Capacitors]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
*Handover 5 [[Bundle of wires]] to [[Mechanic]]
*Handover 5 [[Capacitors]] to [[Mechanic]]

==Rewards==
* +17,200 [[EXP]]
*[[Mechanic]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.01'''</font>
* 40,000 Roubles
** 42,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 46,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 2× [[Physical Bitcoin]]
* Unlocks purchase of [[HK USP .45 ACP pistol]] (variant Match) at [[Mechanic]] LL3
{{quote|Now we’re talking! I’ll grab a soldering iron and get to work. Perhaps the market's gonna stabilize already by that time.}}

==Guide==
Wires and capacitors can most commonly be found in [[PC block]]s, in tech stores on [[Interchange]] such as TechLight, Texho, or Rasmussen, they can also be crafted in the hideout.
